en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard. The image side is divided into three vertical panels: on the left, a former mosque with a tall slender minaret and domed roof set among trees; in the center, a broad terraced garden with fountains leading up to a large Romanesque cathedral with four towers; on the right, a monumental statue of a standing man atop an ornate pedestal with seated figures around the base, located in an urban square. The message side shows handwritten Hungarian text, a green 40f Hungarian postage stamp labeled "MAGYAR POSTA" and "SIMONTORNYA", and an address in Budapest.
